dmp.description: During my visit in Kristineberg, I will collect pipefish samples that will be used for DNA sequencing. I will re-sequence whole-genomes for 15 individuals of Syngnathus typhle and 15 individuals of Nerophis ophidion. Once sequenced, the raw data needs to be deposited in a public repository and so does the resulting processed data. I will mainly be using ENA for sequencing data and ERDA (openly accessible data archive of the University of Copenhagen) for all associated meta-data and resulting analyses.
